title: Generic permanent_ryser over FiniteField
description:
Implement the generic `permanent_ryser<F: FiniteField>` over arbitrary `FiniteField`, using the shared `gray_code_iter`. This is the correctness oracle for every packed permanent kernel.

## Background

Ryser's formula computes the permanent of an $n \times n$ matrix $A$ over a field as

$$
\operatorname{perm}(A) = (-1)^n \sum_{S \subseteq [n], S \ne \emptyset} (-1)^{|S|} \prod_{i=1}^n \sum_{j \in S} a_{i,j}
$$

Walked in Gray-code subset order, the inner column-sum vector updates by a single column add/sub per step. This issue implements the generic version directly over the project's `FiniteField` trait, using `gray_code_iter` (T6). It serves as the correctness oracle for `permanent_mod3_reference` (T8), `permanent_bipedal3` (T9), `permanent_bipedal5` (T18), and `permanent_bipedal7` (T20).

The implementation is intentionally not specialised — clarity over speed. Performance lives in T9/T18/T20.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] [hard] `gf2-algebra::permanent::permanent_ryser<F: FiniteField>(matrix: &[F], n: usize) -> F` exists.
- [ ] [hard] Implementation walks `gray_code_iter(n)` and updates a column-sum `Vec<F>` in-place; the inner loop uses one `F::add` or `F::sub` per Gray-code step plus one `fold` of `F::mul` over the column sum.
- [ ] [hard] Correctness tested against direct $n!$-summation for $n \in \{1, 2, 3, 4, 5\}$ over `Fp<3>`, `Fp<5>`, `Fp<7>` on 100 random matrices each.
- [ ] [hard] Hand-checked test vectors: identity matrix permanent = 1; all-ones matrix permanent = $n!$ over the field.
- [ ] [hard] `cargo nextest run -p gf2-algebra --release --profile ci` passes; bounded $n \le 5$ keeps each test under 5 s.
